   565	      K ⊗[B] (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   566	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)) ≠ 0 :=
   567	    away_one_tmul_one_tmul_ne_zero f y hy q
   568	  have hyB : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B]
   569	      (P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y)) :
   570	      K ⊗[B] Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0) ≠ 0 :=
   571	    P.h0BaseChange_one_tmul_ne_zero B K y hiter
   572	  have hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair (P.datum.baseChange B)).H1 :=
   573	    P.datumPair_h1_baseChange B
   574	  let yB : Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
   575	    P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y)
   576	  change (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop K
   577	    (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   578	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   579	      isTerminalTop (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf yB) ≠ 0
   580	  exact sectionsMapTop_ne_zero_of_one_tmul_ne_zero
   581	    (P.datum.baseChange B) hH1 yB hyB

   583	/-- A rank-one presentation has a tied local-away evaluation generator.
   584	
   585	The rank-one field of `P` makes every residue-field fibre of its `H⁰` module nontrivial.
   586	The projective-module generator lemma therefore supplies a single basic open `D(f)` and
   587	one datum section `y` which stays nonzero on every residue fibre over that open.  The same
   588	`y` is transported to a native global section and its unit-lift through the evaluation
   589	counit; the final conjunct records that counit identity explicitly so the future
   590	`divisorOfRankOne` construction consumes this witness rather than an unrelated section.
   591	-/
   592	theorem exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator
   593	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   594	    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
   595	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   596	      ∃ y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0,
   597	        (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
   598	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   599	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   600	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) ∧
   601	        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   602	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   603	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   604	          (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
   605	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
   606	  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
   607	  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective
   608	  have hfr : Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   609	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) = 1 := by
   610	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]
   611	    exact P.h0_rank_one p
   612	  haveI : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) :=
   613	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
   614	  haveI : Nontrivial (Q ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   615	    (TensorProduct.comm P.cover.Carrier _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial
   616	  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy⟩ :=
   617	    Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective p (Q := Q)
   618	      (by infer_instance)
   619	  refine ⟨f, hf, y, ?_, ?_⟩
   620	  · simpa only [Q] using hy
   621	  · exact P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y
   622	
   623	/-- The fibrewise-regular local equations cut by a tied local-away datum section.
   624	
   625	The nonvanishing proof is derived by
   626	`sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero`; it is not additional witness data.
   627	Together with `exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator`, this is the immediate local divisor
   628	consumer on the datum side.  Identifying it with the native evaluation zero locus remains
   629	a separate `O`-module base-change contract. -/
   630	noncomputable def baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations
   631	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   632	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   633	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   634	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   635	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   636	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   637	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   638	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   639	    (relCurve C (Localization.Away f)).LocalEquations :=
   640	  P.sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   641	    (Localization.Away f) y
   642	    (fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q)
   643	
   644	/-- The local equations cut by the tied datum section represent its base-changed
   645	cocycle datum. -/
   646	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass
   647	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   648	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   649	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   650	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   651	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   652	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   653	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   654	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   655	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).picClass =
   656	      (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass := by
   657	  unfold baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations
   658	  exact P.sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange_picClass
   659	    (Localization.Away f) y
   660	    (fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q)

   697	/-- The cocycle datum tied to a genus-degree presentation has class degree `genus C`
   698	after every field-valued coefficient extension.
   699	
   700	The proof follows the presentation itself: restrict `lam` to its etale-cover carrier,
   701	identify that class with `representative`, rewrite it as the datum's relative Picard class,
   702	and read the defining degree condition of `lam`. -/
   703	theorem datum_classDeg_baseChange
   704	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   705	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
   706	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
   707	    classDeg L
   708	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   709	        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C := by
   710	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   711	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   712	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] L :=
   713	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier L).restrictScalars k
   714	  have hcurve :
   715	      relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L =
   716	        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi).left := by
   717	    refine congrArg
   718	      (fun f : overSpec k L ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   719	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   720	  have hpresentation :
   721	      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 =
   722	        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   723	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   724	    exact picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   725	      C lam.1 P.cover P.representative P.represents.symm
   726	  calc
   727	    classDeg L
   728	        (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   729	          P.datum.cechPicClass) =
   730	      relPicDeg L
   731	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
   732	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   733	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) :=
   734	      (relPicDeg_relPicMk L _).symm
   735	    _ = relPicDeg L
   736	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   737	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   738	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
   739	      rw [relPicMap_mk, ← hcurve]
   740	      rfl
   741	    _ = relPicDeg L
   742	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   743	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   744	      rw [P.datum_class]
   745	    _ = degAt
   746	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   747	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)))
   748	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) :=
   749	      (degAt_relPicToPicEt
   750	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))
   751	        (Over.overSpecMap psi)).symm
   752	    _ = degAt (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1)
   753	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) := by rw [hpresentation]
   754	    _ = degAt lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) :=
   755	      degAt_picEtMap (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   756	    _ = genus C := lam.2 L (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota)
   757

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/
    37	
    38	set_option autoImplicit false
    39	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    40	
    41	universe u
    42	
    43	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    44	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    45	
    46	open scoped TensorProduct

    48	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

    50	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    51	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    52	
    53	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    54	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    55	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    56	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    57	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    58	
    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
    60	
    61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
    62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
    63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
    64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    69	  represents :
    70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    72	  datum_class :
    73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
    76	  module_iso :
    77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
    79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
    80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
    87	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    88	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    89	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    90	  h0_rank_one :
    91	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    92	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1

    98	noncomputable local instance presentationModuleSections
    99	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) (U : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens) :

   127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.
   128	
   129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
   130	`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
   131	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   132	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   133	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   134	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   135	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   136	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   137	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
   138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   139	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
   141	  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)
   142	    (P.native_pushforward_base_change g f' g' sq)
   143	
   144	/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
   145	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   146	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   147	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   148	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   149	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
   150	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   151	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   152	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   153	        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
   154	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
   155	  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
   156	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   157	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   158	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   159	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))
   160	
   161	/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
   162	cartesian base change. -/
   163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
   171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
   175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
   176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
   180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
   182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)
   183	
   184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
   185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
   186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
   194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
   196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
   197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'

   383	/-- Nonvanishing on every residue-field fibre of `D(f)` survives passage from the
   384	corresponding prime of the original ring to the residue field of a prime of `A_f`.
   385

   387	residue-field maps.  Keeping this as a private module lemma prevents the rank-one
   388	construction from depending on a false definitional transitivity of datum base change. -/

   390	    {A Q : Type u} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q]
   391	    (f : A) (y : Q)
   392	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   393	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   394	        Q ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   395	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   396	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   397	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   398	  let p : PrimeSpectrum A :=
   399	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) q
   400	  have hfp : f ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   401	    intro hf
   402	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
   403	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hf) ?_)
   404	    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit f
   405	  have hp : ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   406	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   407	    have h := (TensorProduct.comm A Q p.asIdeal.ResidueField).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
   408	      (hy p hfp)
   409	    simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h
   410	  have hcom : p.asIdeal =
   411	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl
   412	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   413	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
   414	      (Algebra.ofId A (Localization.Away f)) hcom
   415	  have hrho : Function.Bijective rho :=
   416	    (RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f)
   417	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective
   418	        p.asIdeal q.asIdeal hcom
   419	  let e : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃ₗ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   420	    LinearEquiv.ofBijective rho.toLinearMap hrho
   421	  have he := (e.rTensor Q).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr hp
   422	  simpa only [LinearEquiv.rTensor_tmul, e, LinearEquiv.ofBijective_apply,
   423	    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_one] using he

    14	This module is the first divisor consumer of PicRankOneLocalPresentation.  The projective
    15	rank-one H0 module supplies a basic open and a section which is nonzero on every residue fibre
    16	there.  The datum-side section construction then gives regular local equations, and the widened

    20	family-level divisorOfRankOne, identify the equations with the native zero locus, or assert
    21	that the rank-one locus is represented by an open subscheme.  Those remain the next contracts.

   225	/-- The Abel value of the local divisor is the restriction of the input Picard datum.  This is
   226	the immediate consumer which keeps the widened divisor tied to the chosen presentation. -/
   227	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff
   228	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   229	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   230	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   231	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   232	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   233	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   234	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   235	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   236	    abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away f) (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
   237	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
   238	        (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   239	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   240	  let B := Localization.Away f
   241	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   242	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   243	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] B :=
   244	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier B).restrictScalars k
   245	  let F := P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy
   246	  have hFclass : F.picClass = (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass :=
   247	    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy
   248	  have hrel : (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass =
   249	      relPicAlgMap C psi (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   250	    rw [hFclass, P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
   251	    have hcurve : Over.Hom.left (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi) =
   252	        relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B := by
   253	      refine congrArg (fun f : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   254	      exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   255	    rw [P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B, hcurve]
   256	    rfl
   257	  calc
   258	    abelDivAffPlus C B F = PicEtAff.unit C B ((relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass) := rfl
   259	    _ = PicEtAff.unit C B (relPicAlgMap C psi
   260	      (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by rw [hrel]
   261	    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi
   262	      (PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
   263	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   264	      rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit]
   265	    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi (PicEtAff.mapAlg C iota (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   266	      congr 1
   267	      rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]

   583	/-- A rank-one presentation has a tied local-away evaluation generator.
   584	
   585	The rank-one field of `P` makes every residue-field fibre of its `H⁰` module nontrivial.
   586	The projective-module generator lemma therefore supplies a single basic open `D(f)` and
   587	one datum section `y` which stays nonzero on every residue fibre over that open.  The same
   588	`y` is transported to a native global section and its unit-lift through the evaluation
   589	counit; the final conjunct records that counit identity explicitly so the future
   590	`divisorOfRankOne` construction consumes this witness rather than an unrelated section.
   591	-/
   592	theorem exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator
   593	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   594	    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
   595	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   596	      ∃ y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0,
   597	        (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
   598	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   599	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   600	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) ∧
   601	        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   602	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   603	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   604	          (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by

   698	after every field-valued coefficient extension.
   699	
   700	The proof follows the presentation itself: restrict `lam` to its etale-cover carrier,
   701	identify that class with `representative`, rewrite it as the datum's relative Picard class,
   702	and read the defining degree condition of `lam`. -/
   703	theorem datum_classDeg_baseChange
   704	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   705	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
   706	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
   707	    classDeg L
   708	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   709	        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C := by
   710	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   711	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   712	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] L :=
   713	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier L).restrictScalars k
   714	  have hcurve :
   715	      relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L =
   716	        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi).left := by
   717	    refine congrArg
   718	      (fun f : overSpec k L ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   719	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   720	  have hpresentation :
   721	      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 =
   722	        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   723	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   724	    exact picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   725	      C lam.1 P.cover P.representative P.represents.symm
   726	  calc
   727	    classDeg L
   728	        (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   729	          P.datum.cechPicClass) =
   730	      relPicDeg L
   731	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
   732	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   733	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) :=
   734	      (relPicDeg_relPicMk L _).symm
   735	    _ = relPicDeg L
   736	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   737	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   738	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
   739	      rw [relPicMap_mk, ← hcurve]
   740	      rfl
   741	    _ = relPicDeg L
   742	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   743	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   744	      rw [P.datum_class]
   745	    _ = degAt
   746	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   747	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)))
   748	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) :=
   749	      (degAt_relPicToPicEt
   750	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))
   751	        (Over.overSpecMap psi)).symm
   752	    _ = degAt (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1)
   753	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) := by rw [hpresentation]
   754	    _ = degAt lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) :=
   755	      degAt_picEtMap (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   756	    _ = genus C := lam.2 L (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota)

   406	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by

   411	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl
   412	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=

   417	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective

    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    21	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    22	-/

    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    58	
    59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    60	
    61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    62	
    63	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    64	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    66	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    67	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    68	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    69	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    70	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    71	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    72	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    73	
    74	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    75	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    76	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    77	contract. -/
    78	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    79	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    80	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    81	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    82	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    83	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    84	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    85	  rfl
    86	
    87	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
    88	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    89	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    90	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    91	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    92	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    93	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    94	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    95	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
    96	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
    97	
    98	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
    99	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
   100	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   101	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   102	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
   103	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   104	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h
   105	
   106	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
   107	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
   108	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
   109	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   110	
   111	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   112	
   113	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
   114	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
   115	relative-open gate below. -/
   116	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
   117	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
   118	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
   119	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   120	
   121	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
   122	
   123	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
   124	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
   125	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
   126	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
   127	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
   128	
   129	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
   130	
   131	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
   132	
   133	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
   134	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
   135	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
   136	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
   137	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   138	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   141	  W : X.Opens
   142	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   143	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
   144	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   145	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
   146	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
   147	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   148	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   149	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   150	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
   151	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   152	
   153	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   154	
   155	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   156	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   157	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
   158	
   159	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
   160	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   161	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
   162	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   163	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   164	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   165	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   166	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
   167	      φ.app S) D.sq
   168	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   169	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
   170	  · intro v w hvw
   171	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   172	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
   173	
   174	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   175	
   176	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
   177	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
   178	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   179	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   180	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
   181	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   182	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   183	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
   184	  intro X g
   185	  let d := D X g
   186	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
   187	
   188	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
   189	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
   190	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
   191	  h
   192	
   193	/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
   194	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
   195	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
   196	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
   197	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
   198	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   199	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
   200	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
   201	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
   202	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
   203	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
   204	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   205	  h.property g fst snd hpb
   206	
   207	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
   208	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   209	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   210	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   211	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   212	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h
   213	
   214	/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
   215	theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   216	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   217	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   218	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   219	  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h
   220	
   221	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
   222	
   223	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
   224	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
   225	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
   226	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
   227	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   228	
   229	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
   230	representer. -/
   231	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
   232	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
   233	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
   234	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   235	
   236	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   237	def rankOneAbelAff :
   238	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
   239	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   240	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   241	
   242	/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   243	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
   244	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   245	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
   246	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
   247	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   248	
   249	/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   250	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
   251	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   252	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   253	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
   254	
   255	/-- Immediate consumer theorem: the restricted represented Abel map lands in the public locus.
   256	The stronger canonical inverse still needs the family-level divisor/evaluation producer; this
   257	theorem records the exact target API that consumer lanes can use today. -/
   258	theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_mem {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   259	    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
   260	    ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x :
   261	      (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
   262	  ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x).property

     9	/-!
    10	# The universal divisor rank-one open contract
    11	
    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
    16	representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.
    17	
    18	This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    35	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    36	
    37	noncomputable section
    38	
    39	/-- The universal genus-divisor predicate whose Abel class lies in `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
    40	def divRankOneUniversalPredicate :
    41	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    42	  divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi
    43	
    44	/-- Evaluation of the represented genus Abel map on a slice point, with the base morphism
    45	transported from the point in the divisor representer to its source. -/
    46	theorem abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne
    47	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    48	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    49	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.left) q.left =
    50	      (⟨T.hom,
    51	        (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    52	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩ :
    53	        (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    54	          (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) := by
    55	  change (⟨q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom, _⟩ :
    56	      (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	        (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) =
    58	    ⟨T.hom,
    59	      (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    60	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩
    61	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext
    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) q.w ?_
    63	  let e : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶ T :=
    64	    Over.mkCongr q.w
    65	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶
    66	      divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
    67	    Over.homMk q.left rfl
    68	  have hq : e ≫ q = q' := by
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact Category.id_comp _
    71	  change (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map e.op
    72	      ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    73	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)) =
    74	    (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app
    75	      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)))
    76	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q')
    77	  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    78	    ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).naturality e.op)
    79	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)
    80	  have hhom :
    81	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    82	        (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    83	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) := by
    84	    calc
    85	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    86	          (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (e ≫ q) := by
    87	            rw [hq]
    88	      _ = (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    89	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) :=
    90	        (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp e q
    91	  rw [hhom]
    92	  simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hnat.symm
    93	
    94	/-- A represented genus divisor lies in the universal predicate exactly when its Abel image
    95	lifts through the single public rank-one Picard locus. -/
    96	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma
    97	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    98	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    99	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   100	      ∃ v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   101	          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (op T.unop.left),
   102	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left) v =
   103	          (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left := by
   104	  simp only [divRankOneUniversalPredicate,
   105	    divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter,
   106	    Subfunctor.preimage_obj, Set.mem_preimage]
   107	  let p := (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   108	    ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv x)
   109	  change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔ _
   110	  have hleft :
   111	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left =
   112	        (⟨T.unop.hom, p⟩ :
   113	          (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   114	            (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj
   115	              (op T.unop.left)) :=
   116	    abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne x
   117	  constructor
   118	  · intro hp
   119	    refine ⟨⟨T.unop.hom, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   120	    rw [hleft]
   121	    rfl
   122	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   123	    rw [hleft] at hv
   124	    dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   125	      CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at hv
   126	    rcases v with ⟨a, y⟩
   127	    dsimp at hv
   128	    have hfirst : a = T.unop.hom :=
   129	      congrArg (fun z => z.1) hv
   130	    cases hfirst
   131	    have hinj := Sigma.mk.inj hv
   132	    have heq :
   133	        ConcreteCategory.hom
   134	            ((PicRankOneOpen pi).ι.app
   135	              (op (Over.mk T.unop.hom))) y = p :=
   136	      eq_of_heq hinj.2
   137	    change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T
   138	    rw [← heq]
   139	    exact y.property
   140	
   141	/-- The Yoneda map induced by the inclusion of an open of an object in the slice.  Naming this
   142	map is useful to consumers which need the actual factorisation through the open, rather than only
   143	the proposition that a point lies in its range. -/
   144	def openSubfunctorMap (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   145	    yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) ⟶ yoneda.obj D :=
   146	  yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) U.ι)
   147	
   148	/-- The subfunctor represented by an open `U` of an object `D` in the slice over `Spec k`.
   149	
   150	Its values are precisely morphisms which factor through the open immersion `U.ι`; using the
   151	Yoneda range keeps this definition independent of any chosen affine presentation of `U`. -/
   152	def openSubfunctor (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   153	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj D) :=
   154	  Subfunctor.range (openSubfunctorMap D U)
   155	
   156	/-- Unpack range membership into the actual source point and its equality in the ambient Yoneda
   157	functor.  This is the pointwise factorisation API used by inverse constructions. -/
   158	theorem openSubfunctor_mem_iff
   159	    (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens)
   160	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   161	    (x : (yoneda.obj D).obj T) :
   162	    x ∈ (openSubfunctor D U).obj T ↔
   163	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom))).obj T,
   164	        (openSubfunctorMap D U).app T y = x := by
   165	  rfl
   166	
   167	/-- An explicit geometric certificate for the universal rank-one predicate.
   168	
   169	The equality is the missing family-level producer/gluing statement: it identifies the logical
   170	preimage with an actual open of the canonical genus representer.  No default or top-open witness
   171	is manufactured here. -/
   172	structure DivRankOneOpenData (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] where
   173	  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens
   174	  carrier_eq :
   175	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) carrier =
   176	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi
   177	
   178	/-- Genuine relative openness of the public Picard rank-one locus produces the universal
   179	divisor rank-one open.  The carrier is the open image of the represented pullback of the Abel
   180	map, and the proof below identifies its Yoneda range with the defining predicate. -/
   181	theorem divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen
   182	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) :
   183	    Nonempty (DivRankOneOpenData pi) := by
   184	  obtain ⟨X, snd, fst, hpb⟩ := h.rep (abelDivAffGenusSigma C)
   185	  letI : IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   186	    h.property (abelDivAffGenusSigma C) fst snd hpb
   187	  let U := snd.opensRange
   188	  refine ⟨⟨U, ?_⟩⟩
   189	  ext T x
   190	  rw [openSubfunctor_mem_iff]
   191	  rw [divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma]
   192	  have hpbT := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op T.unop.left)

+/-- Evaluation of the represented genus Abel map on a slice point, with the base morphism
+transported from the point in the divisor representer to its source. -/
+theorem abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne
+    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
+    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
+    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.left) q.left =

+        (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
+          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩ :
+        (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
+          (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) := by
+  change (⟨q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom, _⟩ :
+      (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
+        (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) =
+    ⟨T.hom,
+      (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
+        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩
+  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext
+    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) q.w ?_
+  let e : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶ T :=
+    Over.mkCongr q.w
+  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶
+      divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
+    Over.homMk q.left rfl
+  have hq : e ≫ q = q' := by
+    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
+    exact Category.id_comp _
+  change (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map e.op
+      ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
+        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)) =
+    (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app
+      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)))
+      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q')
+  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
+    ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).naturality e.op)
+      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)
+  have hhom :
+      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
+        (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
+          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) := by
+    calc
+      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =

+          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) :=

+  simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hnat.symm

+  · intro hp
+    refine ⟨⟨T.unop.hom, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩, ?_⟩
+    rw [hleft]
+    rfl
+  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
+    rw [hleft] at hv

+/-- Genuine relative openness of the public Picard rank-one locus produces the universal
+divisor rank-one open.  The carrier is the open image of the represented pullback of the Abel
+map, and the proof below identifies its Yoneda range with the defining predicate. -/

+    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) :
+    Nonempty (DivRankOneOpenData pi) := by

+  rw [divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma]

+      rw [← Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange snd]
+      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
+      rw [hxy, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]

+        (fst.app (op T.unop.left) u) =
+      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) (u ≫ snd) at hcomm
+    simpa only [hu] using hcomm
+  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
+    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := hpbT.2.2 v x.left hv
+    change u ≫ snd = x.left at hu₂

+      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]

+      subst e

      "body": "[persistent] [persistent] REPRESENTABILITY PUSH, 2026-07-29 \u2014 the claim/lane protocol that makes 10 free-objective lanes not collide.\n\nWHY THIS EXISTS. This round replaces prescriptive per-leaf tasks with FIVE lanes per project: one REVIEWER and four PROVERS ranked p1..p4. The provers each pick their own target. That only works if claiming is explicit and public. This item is the claiming mechanism. Read it before your first edit.\n\nTHE FIVE LANES PER PROJECT\n- `review-ajc` / `review-ajcr` \u2014 reviewer. Read-mostly. Finds defects of ROUTE and ORGANISATION, not of individual proofs; may propose refactors and file tasks-as-proposals for the provers. Does not race provers for proof work.\n- `ajc-p1` / `ajcr-p1` \u2014 takes the MOST important open representability item.\n- `-p2`, `-p3`, `-p4` \u2014 2nd, 3rd, 4th most important, where \"important\" is measured against the project's representability headline, not by ease.\n\nCLAIMING \u2014 do this BEFORE you start proving, not after.\n 1. `horizon roadmap list --focus <your project's w4-rep / picrep subtree>` and read the reviewer's open notes.\n 2. Pick your item. Check no other lane owns it: an item with `--owner` set to another lane IS CLAIMED. Do not take it, even if you think you would be faster.\n 3. Claim it: `horizon roadmap set <id> --owner <your-task-id> --status active`. If your target is not yet a roadmap item, `roadmap add` it under the right parent first, then claim it.\n 4. Announce: one `horizon inbox add --kind info --to horizon --body \"CLAIM <lane>: <roadmap id> \u2014 <one line on what discharging it buys>\"`.\n 5. Release on exit: if you did NOT finish, `roadmap set <id> --owner ''` and leave a one-line inbox note saying where you stopped and what the next lane should NOT re-derive. An item left owned by a dead lane is worse than an unclaimed one.\n\nRANK IS A TIE-BREAK, NOT A FENCE. If p1's item turns out to be blocked on p3's, say so in the inbox and swap \u2014 rank exists so four lanes do not all converge on the same top item, not to stop you working on the right thing. p1 has first refusal on any contested item.\n\nYOU MAY PROPOSE WORK TO THE OTHER LANES. Direct-message with `horizon inbox add --kind hint --to task:<lane-id> --body \"\u2026\"`. A good proposal names the declaration, the file, and why it is worth more than what that lane currently holds. You may NOT reassign another lane's claimed item, and you may NOT create new horizon runs or tasks for teams outside your own (`horizon permissions` is false on both counts \u2014 propose to the human instead).\n\nSTANDING BINDING DECISIONS you must not relitigate: `I-0491` (AJC: no rational-point binder on the headline; `hasRationalPoint_of_curve` is FALSE and must be deleted, never proved) and `I-0492` (AJCR: `DivFamZar` widens to arbitrary affine opens; do NOT build the GL_2/Aut(P1) route). Read both.\n\nWHAT COUNTS AS PROGRESS, given the 2026-07-29 audit. That audit found 99 of 101 sampled representability claims refuted: 67 sorry-reachable, 17 VACUOUS, 12 hypothesis-shifted. So the bar is explicit:\n- A discharged obligation must be sorry-free AND its hypotheses must be inhabitable. Before you claim a gate closed, exhibit a witness for every antecedent, or say plainly which antecedent is still undischarged.\n- Do NOT add a class, structure field, or hypothesis whose statement does not mention the object it is supposedly about. `HasDivFunctor` is the cautionary case: its field asserted only that a presheaf category is nonempty, `C` did not occur, and it was advertised as the existence of the relative divisor functor. That is a vacuity, and it survived because nobody read the statement.\n- Do NOT discharge an obligation by projecting the hypothesis you assumed (`choose_spec.1` of your own binder). That is `P \u2192 P`.\n- A green `lake build` is not evidence a statement is non-vacuous. Check imports are current before believing a `lean_multi_attempt` success.\n\nCOMMIT DISCIPLINE. This is ONE shared ledger branch with 10 writers. Another lane's integrate sweep can commit your half-written file before you have measured it once. Write risky proofs as explicit `sorry` first, measure, then fill. Stage explicit files, never `add -A`.",

/-- The widened divisor cut by a tied rank-one section on its basic open. -/
noncomputable def baseOpenRankOneDivisor
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away f) (genus C) :=
  divFamZarAffOfFibrewiseRegularLocalEquations C (genus C)
    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) pi
    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular f y hy)
    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_classDeg f y hy)

@[simp]
theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy).picClass =
      (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass := by
  unfold baseOpenRankOneDivisor
  rw [picClass_divFamZarAffOfFibrewiseRegularLocalEquations]
  exact P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass f y hy

/-- The Abel value of the local divisor is the restriction of the input Picard datum.  This is
the immediate consumer which keeps the widened divisor tied to the chosen presentation. -/
theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away f) (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
        (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
  let B := Localization.Away f
  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] B :=
    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier B).restrictScalars k
  let F := P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy
  have hFclass : F.picClass = (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass :=
    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy
  have hrel : (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass =
      relPicAlgMap C psi (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
    rw [hFclass, P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
    have hcurve : Over.Hom.left (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi) =
        relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B := by
      refine congrArg (fun f : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
      exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
    rw [P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B, hcurve]
    rfl
  calc
    abelDivAffPlus C B F = PicEtAff.unit C B ((relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass) := rfl
    _ = PicEtAff.unit C B (relPicAlgMap C psi
      (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by rw [hrel]
    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi
      (PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
      rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit]
    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi (PicEtAff.mapAlg C iota (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
      congr 1
      rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]

/-- Every base point of a rank-one presentation has a tied local widened divisor.  The final
conjunct retains the native counit identity for the very same section. -/
theorem exists_baseOpen_rankOne_divisor_with_evaluation
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      ∃ (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
        (hy : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0),
        (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy).picClass =
            (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass ∧
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
            ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
              (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
            (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy, heval⟩ := P.exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator p
  exact ⟨f, hf, y, hy, P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy, heval⟩

/-- Every base point has one tied local divisor whose Abel value is the restriction of the
input class and whose defining section satisfies the native evaluation identity. -/
theorem exists_baseOpen_rankOne_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      ∃ (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
        (hy : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0),
        abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away f) (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
            PicEtAff.mapAlg C
              ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
              (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
                (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) ∧
          (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy).picClass =
              (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass ∧
            (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
              ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
                (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
              (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy, hclass, heval⟩ :=
    P.exists_baseOpen_rankOne_divisor_with_evaluation p
  exact ⟨f, hf, y, hy, P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff f y hy, hclass, heval⟩

end PicRankOneLocalPresentation

events.text: The audit confirms the honest Phase 4 boundary: the local Abel inverse is already constructed pointwise on basic opens, while the missing mathematics is choice independence plus gluing/native-zero-locus comparison. I’m targeting the first of those directly, so the new theorem will identify the two local divisor classes produced by different rank-one generators rather than merely restating their equal Abel values.

data.content:
noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
cartesian base change. -/
noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)

/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module


/-! ## The datum/native-section/evaluation bridge -/

/-- The global datum section represented by a degree-zero cohomology class. -/
noncomputable def datumSection (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
    P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op (⊤ : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens)) :=
  Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))

def DivFamZar : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarSetoid C R π n)

namespace DivFamZar

variable {C R π n}

/-- The class of a locally certified system. -/
def mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) :

    {h₁ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₁} {h₂ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₂} :
    mk d₁ h₁ = mk d₂ h₂ ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁ d₂ :=
  Quotient.eq (r := divFamZarSetoid C R π n)

the quotient by `picClass_eq_of_divEq`. -/

  Quotient.lift
    (fun d : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} =>
      d.1.picClass)
    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_eq_of_divEq h) F

    (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) : picClass (mk d hd) = d.picClass :=
  rfl

    ((relCurve C B).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
        𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y' ≤ 𝒲.opens y)).op).hom
        ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y) (D.component s (σ y)))
      = (gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y' :
            Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y'))
        * ((relCurve C B).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right :
            𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y' ≤ 𝒲.opens y')).op).hom
            ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y') (D.component s (σ y'))) := by
  have hle : 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y'

    le_inf (le_inf le_top (inf_le_left.trans (hσ y))) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y'))
  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C B).resHom hle) (s.property (σ y) (σ y'))
  rw [map_mul] at key

    (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),

    ⟨gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y', D.component_ratio_eq s 𝒲 σ hσ y y'⟩

    [IsNoetherianRing B]

      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
    (D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).picClass = D.cechPicClass :=
  D.sectionLocalEquations_picClass s D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex (fun _ => le_rfl) _

namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]

section AffineHom

variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)

/-- The `j`-th **component** of a global section of the datum's glued sheaf, as a
section of the trivializing basic-open piece `D(h_j)` (the `⊤ ⊓ pieces j`-to-`pieces j`
restriction of the matching family's `j`-th entry). -/
noncomputable def component (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
    (j : D.index) : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
  (relCurve C B).resHom (le_inf le_top le_rfl) (s.val j)

/-- Every piece of the pinned datum is an affine open (a basic open of a pinned affine
chart). -/
theorem isAffineOpen_pieces (j : D.index) : IsAffineOpen (D.pieces j) := by
  cases j with
  | inl j₀ => exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen (D.h₀ j₀)
  | inr j₁ => exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen (D.h₁ j₁)

end AffineHom

variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)

/-- **DAT-A2 on the datum, section-ring form**: a fibrewise-regular component of a
global section of the DAT-1 glued sheaf is a nonzerodivisor of its piece ring
(fibrewise-regular + flat ⟹ regular; the chart rings are free `B`-modules by
`free_relSections`, so the pieces are flat, and the `lm:ctn`-lite core fires). -/
theorem component_mem_nonZeroDivisors [IsNoetherianRing B]

  D.sectionsMap B' (by rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]) s

theorem component_sectionsMapTop (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)

-- The glued trivialization carries a large dependent family of section rings.
-- A nonzero global section of a cocycle-glued line bundle on an integral scheme is
-- nonzero in every nonempty trivializing piece.
namespace Scheme

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

/-! ## Restriction between basic opens as an algebra map -/

/-- Restriction of sections between nested basic opens, as a map of algebras over the
global sections.  (Both algebra structures are the canonical restriction instances.) -/
def basicRes (g h : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hle : X.basicOpen h ≤ X.basicOpen g) :
    Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) →ₐ[Γ(X, ⊤)] Γ(X, X.basicOpen h) where
  toRingHom := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom
  commutes' a := by
    change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom
        ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom a)
      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom a
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]

@[simp]
lemma basicRes_apply (g h : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hle : X.basicOpen h ≤ X.basicOpen g)
    (s : Γ(X, X.basicOpen g)) :
    basicRes g h hle s = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op s :=
  rfl

/-- The unit-level restriction between basic opens is `basicRes` on values. -/
lemma coe_unitsRestrict_basicOpen (g h : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hle : X.basicOpen h ≤ X.basicOpen g)
    (u : Γ(X, X.basicOpen g)ˣ) :
    (X.unitsRestrict hle u : Γ(X, X.basicOpen h)) = basicRes g h hle u.val :=
  rfl

/-- Any two algebra maps over the global sections out of the sections on a basic open of
an affine scheme are equal: the source is a localization of `Γ(X, ⊤)`. -/
theorem basicOpen_algHom_ext [IsAffine X] (g : Γ(X, ⊤)) {C : Type u} [CommRing C]
    [Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) C] (φ ψ : Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) →ₐ[Γ(X, ⊤)] C) : φ = ψ :=
  (IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton (Submonoid.powers g)).elim φ ψ

/-! ## Diagonal normalization of unit cocycles -/

/-- The diagonal value `γ(x,x)` of a unit Čech cocycle on a pointed cover is `1` after
restriction to any open contained in the member at `x`. -/
theorem unitsRestrict_unitsEvInf_self {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (x : X)
    {V : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ 𝒰.opens x) :
    X.unitsRestrict (le_inf hV hV) (unitsEvInf γ x x) = 1 := by
  have e := congrArg
    (X.unitsRestrict (le_inf (le_inf hV hV) hV :
      V ≤ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x)) (unitsEvInf_trans γ x x x)
  simp only [map_mul, unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict] at e
